$comment: Gzipped bytes. entry: the entry chunk with its static imports; routes: a route file's split chunks with the static imports the entry does not already load; css: all emitted CSS. A task that needs more raises the budget in the same PR and says why. U-02 raised entry from 150000 to 175000: the authenticated shell (sidebar, engine switcher, trust mark with SHA-256, user menu, drawer, step-up dialog, toaster, route states) and the Paraglide runtime with both catalogues render on every route, so they belong in the entry; measured 168130. Raised to 200000 on 2026-10-21 (Seb): at 173803 an audit of the entry found it is framework and contract code (react-dom, zod, TanStack Router and Query, engine-api schemas, @ptbk/ui shell components); Paraglide already tree-shakes messages per route, and the only engine-ui code left to split was route loaders (about 1 kB), not worth a serial chunk fetch before every cold navigation. U-04 gave the book editor and the create-agent wizard budgets of their own: both load CodeMirror 6 (view, state, language, lint, search, history; merge for the editor's diff), about 105000 shared, which the entry never loads (ADR 0013). Measured: agents/$agentId/book.tsx 158808 (CodeMirror with merge, the history DataTable), agents/new.tsx 158133 (CodeMirror, the form layer, the knowledge upload, the chat panel for the test step); the entry grew by 413 (the two routes' guards, search schema and loader, and the Book tab's registration). U-13 raised agents/new.tsx from 165000 to 168000: the test step carries the book editor's throwaway test chat beside the kept-chat fallback; measured 165022. U-13 raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 170000 to 171000: the trigger form reuses the book's unsaved-changes guard, so the guard moves into a chunk both routes share; measured 170200. Raised entry from 200000 to 215000 on 2026-11-03: home, where opening an engine lands, is no longer split from the entry (vite.config.ts). Split, it was 23 chunks of 17 kB gzip in all, fetched after the entry ran and queued behind HTTP/1.1's six connections; at Fast 3G its first screen went from 5.4 s to 3.4 s. Measured 209991. C-14 raised entry from 215000 to 217000: the engine-api chat schemas and readers gained reply steps, working agents, linked tasks and rechecks, which every chat read parses; measured 215391. U-16 (part A) raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 171000 to 176000 and agents/new.tsx from 168000 to 171500: both embed a chat (the book's test chat, the wizard's test step), which now carries the reference chips, their parser and hovercards, agent colours and the composer's @ suggestions; measured 175013 and 170543. Lazy-loading the hovercard bodies would save about 1 kB of that and delay every first hover, so they stay in. The entry did not grow: the chat loader's markdown preload moved to a module of its own, so the thread renderers left the entry (measured 215240). U-16 part B raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 176000 to 181500 and agents/new.tsx from 171500 to 176500: both embed the chat panel, which now builds agent turns, steps, task and reply-status cards, day dividers and the interim progress parser; measured 180649 and 175688. U-17 (foundations) raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 181500 to 183000 and agents/new.tsx from 176500 to 178000: their embedded chat's chips now compose @ptbk/ui's EntityChip with its status dot, and a profile colour's label colours are derived per theme (OKLCH lightness search) so arbitrary agent colours stay AA; measured 182377 and 177428. The entry did not grow past its budget (215387). U-17 (tables) raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 181500 to 184000: its history DataTable now carries the restyled table (group headers, header icons, two-line narrow rows, the toolbar hand-off for the filter bar) on top of the foundations' tokens and restyled controls; measured 183362. With the U-17 foundations' restyled controls (Combobox, DateInput, StatusPill, Avatar) merged in, agents/new.tsx measured 177706, so U-17 (tables) raised it from 176500 to 178500. U-17 revision 1 (foundations) raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 184000 to 186000 and agents/new.tsx from 178500 to 180500: the embedded chat's agent and task hovercards are now @ptbk/ui PeekCards (header, status pill, facts, footer action with the Enter shortcut); measured 185352 and 179694. U-17 (shell and screens) kept the entry at 217000: Home turned Chatter-first (the chat composer, entity chips with hovercards, and the Needs you, Working now and Recent chats sections), and that content and the activity feed now load as two chunks the home route starts fetching before it asks the engine anything, so they arrive with the data rather than after it. The greeting, update notice and onboarding notice stay in the entry; measured 207763, and 212788 after the foundations' revision 1. After the foundations' revision 1 the chip core is shared from the entry again, so runs/index.tsx and tasks/index.tsx are back within the default (measured 46005 and 45350) and agents/$agentId/book.tsx fits the foundations' 186000 (measured 185783). U-17 (shell and screens) raised agents/new.tsx from 180500 to 181500: the wizard's test chat now carries the entity chips' code and activity lines; measured 180960. U-17 (shell and screens, revision 2) raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 186000 to 186500: the neutral entity chip's hairline ring ships with the book's test chat; measured 186020. U-17 phase 2 (admin screens) gave audit.tsx 53000 and members.tsx 51000: the audit log moved to the shared DataTable and FilterBar (entity, enum and date-range fields, member chips with their hovercards, the device parser), and Members to the DataTable with avatars, the soft needs-you rows and Combobox role pickers; measured 52497 and 50521. The same PR raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 186500 to 187500, agents/new.tsx from 181500 to 182500 and gave agents/$agentId/files.tsx 50500: none of them changed, but with the admin screens now importing Combobox, FilterBar and Avatar, Rollup regroups the shared chunks these routes load; measured 186886, 181970 and 50030. U-17 phase 2 (work screens) raised these routes, measured after the rebase on phase 1: files.tsx to 62000 (measured 60993), triggers/index.tsx to 54000 (53335), triggers/$triggerId/index.tsx to 51000 (50355), integrations/index.tsx to 52000 (51229), agents/$agentId/files.tsx to 52500 (51822), agents/$agentId/triggers.tsx to 54500 (53624), agents/$agentId/integrations.tsx to 51000 (50082), agents/$agentId/book.tsx to 187500 (187021) and agents/new.tsx to 183000 (182316). The lists moved from native fields to the shared FilterBar with its entity, multi-value and date fields, and their rows now carry entity chips (with the lazily loaded peek cards' triggers), status pills and the row ⋯ menu; the trigger form's native selects became Comboboxes and DateInputs; the file drawer gained chips and an action menu. The agent tabs reuse the same tables, so they grow with them. Splitting the upload dialog into a lazy chunk saved under 3 kB on files.tsx and the chunk itself measured 61187, over the route budget, so the dialog stays in the route. The book and wizard routes grew by about 0.5 kB and 0.8 kB with the shared control height and the PeekCard status wash. The entry stayed within 217000 (measured 213572). With the admin (#291) and work screens (#293) both on main, the shared chunks they import (the restyled controls at one CONTROL_HEIGHT, FilterBar, Combobox, PeekCard's status wash) regroup again, so the merge raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 187500 to 188000, audit.tsx from 53000 to 53500, members.tsx from 51000 to 51500 and gave chats/index.tsx 50500; measured 187521, 53325, 51183 and 50352. U-17 phase 2 (agents) gave agents/index.tsx a budget of its own, 70000: the agents page carries both views, the grid of cards with the morphing agent panel (live step and timer, chats with previews, running tasks with chips) and the table with the filter bar, plus the readers for the three page-level lists it groups by agent (recent chats, active tasks, running runs) and the one status helper; measured 68252. It raised agents/$agentId/files.tsx from 52500 to 58000: the agent's Files tab searches through a filter bar of its own above its two sections; measured 57633. It raised agents/new.tsx from 183000 to 184000 (the wizard's live agent preview and ring stepper; measured 183840) and agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 188000 to 188500 (the test chat's waiting picture and quiet state pill; measured 188159). With the agent avatars now drawing the illustrations, the shared chunks regroup once more, so it raised audit.tsx from 53500 to 54000 and chats/index.tsx from 50500 to 51000, neither of which changed; measured 53553 and 50702. The twenty illustrations load as a lazy chunk of their own (2388), asked for when the avatar module runs, so the entry stays within 217000 (measured 215271). The U-17 follow-up raised agents/$agentId/files.tsx from 58000 to 62000, the Files page's own budget: the tab now filters through the Files page's FileFilters in the table's toolbar (search and scan; the agent and purpose fields go unused there but share the module); measured 61601. The brand kit (U-17) raised entry from 217000 to 220500: the shell draws the official lockup and symbol as inline SVG paths (no image request, theme-aware fills), and the route error and not-found states draw the brand robot, all in the entry because the shell and route states are; measured 219872. Home's robot guide and the onboarding guide load in their lazy chunks (home-content 25416, onboarding 13634). It raised integrations/index.tsx from 52000 to 52500: its empty state carries the robot; measured 52048. The same PR raised members.tsx from 51500 to 52000: unchanged itself, but the DataTable's empty-state illustration slot regroups the shared chunks it loads; measured 51514 in CI. The UI polish follow-up (one scroll in chat, agent pictures in chat, full-width lists) raised agents/new.tsx from 184000 to 184500 and chats/index.tsx from 51000 to 51500: agent chips and chat avatars now look an agent's whole profile up through one shared hook and avatar, which the shared chunks these routes load carry; measured 184114 and 51109. D-31 raised members.tsx from 52000 to 52500: the access approval gained the six-cell code input and the ?request= link; measured 51535. With Home naming each person waiting for access, the shared chunks regroup, so it raised integrations/index.tsx from 52000 to 52500, which did not change; measured 52053. On top of the UI polish follow-up, the same regrouping raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 188500 to 189000 and agents/$agentId/integrations.tsx from 51000 to 51500, neither of which changed; measured 188543 and 51022. D-31 (step-up in place) raised entry from 220500 to 221500: the step-up dialog, which the shell renders on every route, now opens the gateway's step-up page as a popup, waits for its answer on the same-origin channel and repeats the action, and the mutation hook keeps the last call for that retry; measured 221140. C-15 raised entry from 221500 to 222000: the engine-api client, which every route loads, parses onboarding with the new secret prompt, details, alternatives, activity and the reader that reads an unknown prompt kind as unsupported; measured 221587. U-19 adds a lazy Wallet import dialog sharing the existing field, checkbox and input controls and localisation functions. Rolldown regroups their shared chunks by about 180–205 bytes gzip. On the production build, agents/$agentId/chat/index.tsx measured 50174 (main 49987), agents/$agentId/files.tsx 62031 (61851), audit.tsx 54024 (53819), triggers/$triggerId/index.tsx 51127 (50929) and triggers/index.tsx 54173 (53977), so these narrow route budgets grow to 50300, 62300, 54300, 51300 and 54400. The entry budget is unchanged; the import dialog itself is lazy (about 5.5 kB gzip). Rebased on the browser setup screens (#336, #337), agents/$agentId/triggers.tsx measured 54531 through the same regrouping, so it grows from 54500 to 55000; the entry measured 221970. C-16 raised entry from 222000 to 225000: the engine-api route table, which every route loads, gained browser-tab@1's eleven routes with their strict schemas and tolerant readers (sessions, tabs, help requests and the channel's origin rule); measured 224620. It raised audit.tsx from 54300 to 54800: the audit log labels the seven browser.* actions and two targets in both catalogues; measured 54353. U-21 (the live browser's UI) raised entry from 225000 to 226000: what the shell needs on every page while it shows nothing (the browser feature's event sync, the member's live session store, the slot that lazily loads the indicator and the /browser/$sessionId route's guard); measured 225728 after the rebase on C-16. The viewer, the help request item, the run and chat tab list and the indicator are lazy chunks that load only on an engine advertising browser-tab@1. Splitting them into chunks of their own regroups the shared chunks by about 400 bytes, so, measured on the production build after the rebase, it raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx to 189500 (189223), agents/$agentId/chat/index.tsx to 51000 (50606), agents/$agentId/files.tsx to 62500 (62451), agents/$agentId/integrations.tsx to 52000 (51687), agents/new.tsx to 185000 (184624), chats/index.tsx to 52000 (51820), integrations/index.tsx to 53000 (52867), triggers/$triggerId/index.tsx to 52000 (51534) and triggers/index.tsx to 55000 (54583); none of those routes changed. C-17 raised entry from 226000 to 228000: the voice routes, their schemas and the binary body handling are contract code in the route table the client is built from; measured 226838. U-23 raised agents/$agentId/files.tsx from 62500 to 63000: setup now answers through @ptbk/ui's Input and Textarea, so the shared chunks regroup; the route did not change; measured 62503. U-25 (AI tools, with C-18) raised entry from 228000 to 230000: the engine-api route table, which every route loads, gained ai-tools@1's eight routes with their strict schemas and tolerant readers, and the shell carries the feature's Home attention and event sync; measured 229358. The page itself is a lazy route chunk (settings_/ai-tools.tsx, 23941). It raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 189500 to 190000 and agents/new.tsx from 185000 to 185500: their embedded chat's recheck card offers "Sign in again" for a failed reply naming an AI tool; measured 189586 and 185050. It raised audit.tsx from 54800 to 55300: the audit log labels the three ai-tool.* actions and the ai-tool target in both catalogues; measured 54841. C-19 and U-26 (updates) raised entry from 230000 to 231000: the route table every route loads gained updates@1 (the check-now route, the updates.changed event and the new security fields with their readers), and the shell listens for that event on every page to offer a reload; measured 230266. The Settings rows stay in the settings route (21038). Agent Book model settings use the public ptbk parser and source-preserving writer in the Book editor and creation wizard. The two authoring routes gain about 9 kB gzip; Settings stays within the default route budget.
